proposed: Elizabeth Holmes's full legal name is Elizabeth Anne Holmes.
Before 2022, Elizabeth Holmes was the founder and CEO of Theranos.
The jury delivered its verdict in the United States v. Holmes trial on January 3, 2022.
Elizabeth Holmes was found guilty of one count of conspiracy to commit wire fraud against investors and three counts of wire fraud involving investments exceeding $140 million.
The jury acquitted Elizabeth Holmes of one count of patient-related conspiracy to commit wire fraud and three other wire fraud counts.
An additional wire fraud charge related to a Theranos patient was dismissed during the trial.
